messages.subject: Bootcamps 'Statistics for Linguists with R'
messages.body_plain:
Hi all

Some quick self-advertising (with apologies). There are still a small number of slots available in two 'Statistical modeling with R' bootcamps in the summer:
27-31 Aug 2018 at the University of Erfurt in Germany; plz contact Beate Hampe <https://www.uni-erfurt.de/en/anglistik/languagestructure/hampe/> about details if you are interested;
03-07 Sept 2018 at Maria Curie - Skłodowska University in Lublin, Poland; plz check out this website <http://www.umcs.pl/en/rbootcamp.htm> for details if you are interested.
Cheers,
STG
